records.authoritative_rule: Distinct refundable domestic Canadian-content labour credit. Basic 40% of qualified BC labour for productions starting principal photography on/after 2025-01-01; regional 12.5%, distant 6%, training lesser of 30% trainee payments or 3% qualified BC labour, DAVE 16%, scriptwriting 35%. Eligible BC production corporation, Canadian-content/certificate and filing gates apply.
records.territoriality: Qualified BC labour; regional/physical-office rules for relevant uplifts. Local payment alone is insufficient.
records.monetization: Refundable corporate tax credit claimed after Creative BC certification through the tax return.

records.program_name: Refundable Tax Credit for Film Production Services
records.authoritative_rule: Refundable services credit: 25% eligible production costs plus 16% eligible computer VFX/animation labour for qualifying post-2024 applications. Eligible Quebec establishment, SODEC favourable advance ruling/certificate and production eligibility apply. Service-contract VFX component is limited to 65% where specified.
records.territoriality: Services rendered in Quebec or property used in Quebec; Quebec incurrence and SODEC certification. Payer alone is insufficient.
records.monetization: Refundable Quebec corporate tax credit claimed with prescribed form and SODEC documents.

records.authoritative_rule: Current transferable Missouri motion-media credit governed by the SHOW MO Act and DED guidelines. Eligibility, minimum spend, base credit and additions are project/workforce dependent; pre-authorization, qualified Missouri expenditure, final application and statutory annual allocation apply. Encode from the 2023 guidelines and 2026 final form, not a single guaranteed maximum rate.
records.territoriality: Qualified Missouri production/post expenditure and qualifying Missouri workforce/vendor rules; payment channel alone is insufficient.
records.monetization: Transferable state tax credit after final certification; allocation constrained by statutory program authorization.

records.program_name: UK Global Screen Fund — International Co-production
records.authoritative_rule: Competitive non-recoupable grant up to GBP300,000. UK independent producer; film minority co-production or eligible TV animation/documentary structure; at least 60% finance secured (80% fast track), other UK finance, British cultural/treaty qualification, UK contribution thresholds and eligible UK elements. Requested grant cannot exceed 50% of UK financial contribution.
records.territoriality: Grant restricted to UK production elements and treaty/Convention qualifying expenditure or qualifying UK expenditure for unofficial co-productions.
records.monetization: Discretionary non-recoupable grant; current round closed, next scheduled September 2026. Must carry zero guaranteed optimizer value until awarded.

records.authoritative_rule: Distinct 2026 non-repayable grant for high-end series and non-theatrical films: up to 30% eligible German production costs, basis capped at 80% total production costs; film cap EUR5m, ordinary series cap EUR6m/season with separate high-cost series treatment. German applicant/branch, reference production, characteristic test, financing, German-cost minimums, pre-shoot application and ecological standards apply. General pre-costs and pre-existing rights/music are expressly excluded subject to stated exceptions.
records.territoriality: Eligible German production costs under the guideline schedule; actual German production activity/cost predicates, not payer alone.
records.monetization: Non-repayable project grant paid through FFA verification; aid cumulation/intensity rules apply.

records.authoritative_rule: 35% of approved investment in Colombia for non-national audiovisual works produced or post-produced wholly or partly in Colombia after prior CPFC approval. Investment must contract Colombian natural/legal persons supplying necessary audiovisual/cinematographic and qualifying logistical services. Contract, fiduciary, reporting and resource-manual requirements apply.
records.territoriality: Investment in qualifying Colombian persons and services performed for production/post-production in Colombia; payer alone is insufficient.
records.monetization: Negotiable security issued to the foreign producer; may be transferred to Colombian income-tax filers and used under the statutory market/tax mechanism.

records.program_name: Canary Islands Foreign Production Tax Deduction

records.authoritative_rule: Current Navarre producer deduction is generally 45%; 50% on the first EUR3m of basis for enumerated difficult works (Basque-only original, women-directed, documentary, animation, first feature/series director, shorts). EUR5m maximum. Basis is producer investment when Navarre spend reaches 40%; otherwise Navarre spend divided by 0.4. Basis may not exceed 80% of total audiovisual work cost; aid-intensity and certification rules apply.
records.territoriality: Expenses treated as incurred in Navarre under the statutory/Foral Order tests; 40% territorialization controls full-basis treatment.
records.monetization: Corporate tax deduction subject to certification and statutory intensity limits.

records.program_name: Netherlands Film Production Incentive — High-End Series
records.authoritative_rule: ADD as a distinct Filmfonds scheme, not a duplicate of the film-production scheme. Up to 35% demonstrably spent qualifying Dutch production costs, maximum EUR3m per project/year/applicant; drama, documentary and animation series/single episodes; independent eligible applicant; Dutch/foreign broadcast guarantees, minute-cost thresholds, 50% unconditional financing, 75-point test, financing within six months, pre-shoot timing and 36-month delivery.
records.territoriality: Demonstrably spent qualifying Dutch production costs; Annex 1 exclusions and point-linked Dutch activity apply. Payment alone is insufficient.
records.monetization: Cash-rebate-form grant determined and paid after actual qualifying spend; annual EUR9.5m 2026 high-end-series budget and competitive round ranking apply.
